CommunityApplications.Profile: SeerrNG is a Seerr fork for requests across movies, TV, music, books, comics, magazines, ROMs, and PC games. This repository provides a standalone SeerrNG Community Applications template and individual optional companion templates for BookshelfNG, LazyLibrarian, Mylar3, Kapowarr, ROMarrNG, and QuestarrNG. BookshelfNG, ROMarrNG, and QuestarrNG are standalone NG forks with SeerrNG integration contracts; the other companion templates use standalone upstream images. Install only the services you use.
